products.name: Tuga A6
products.tagline: The one that lives in your pocket.
products.shortFor: Photos, job sheets, sign-off and comms — on a phone that survives the site.
products.description: A 6.8 inch rugged Android handheld for tradespeople who need a tough device in their pocket. IP68 and IP69K rated, drop tested to MIL-STD-810H, with a 10600mAh battery and 5G.
products.longDescription: The A6 is the smallest device in the range and the one most people start with. It goes in a pocket or a belt holster, survives being dropped down a stairwell, and still has charge at the end of a long shift. The 64MP night vision camera earns its keep in loft spaces, voids and under floors where a torch and a phone in the same hand is one hand too few. 5G means photos and job sheets upload before you have got back to the van.
highlights: IP68 + IP69K — survives jet washing, not just rain
64MP night vision camera for dark voids and loft spaces
10600mAh battery — two full days of normal site use
5G, so uploads finish before you leave the job
products.positioning: The pocket option. Proof of delivery, quick photos, barcode scanning, comms.

products.name: Tuga A8
products.tagline: The all-rounder. Fits the van door pocket.
products.shortFor: Forms, maps, site photos and quotes — one-handed, all shift.
products.description: An 8 inch rugged Android tablet with IP68 protection, 4G LTE and a sunlight readable screen. The size most tradespeople settle on: big enough for forms and drawings, small enough to hold in one hand.
products.longDescription: Eight inches is the size most people land on once they have tried all three. It is big enough to fill in a form, read a drawing or follow a route without pinching and zooming, and small enough to hold in one hand up a ladder or drop into a van door pocket. Sunlight readable at 800 nits, sealed to IP68, and drop tested to MIL-STD-810H. Vehicle mountable with 4G LTE built in, so it works as a dashboard unit on the road and a site tablet when you get there.
highlights: 800 nit sunlight readable screen — usable on a bright roof
Fits a van door pocket and one hand
10000mAh battery with 4G LTE for remote sites
Vehicle mountable — dashboard unit and site tablet in one
products.positioning: The all-rounder. The sweet spot between portability and screen space.

products.name: Tuga A10
products.tagline: Full-size. For drawings you actually need to read.
products.shortFor: Blueprints, BIM viewers, full spreadsheets and PDF plans.
products.description: A 10.1 inch rugged Android tablet for when you need real screen space. IP68 and IP69K rated, MIL-STD-810H drop tested, with a 10800mAh battery and dual SIM 4G.
products.longDescription: When the job involves drawings, the 8 inch stops being enough. The A10 gives you a full 10.1 inch screen for blueprints, BIM viewers, spreadsheets and PDF plans, in a body sealed to IP68 and IP69K and drop tested to MIL-STD-810H. The 10800mAh battery runs a full shift and then some, and dual SIM 4G keeps you connected across networks on rural and remote sites. This is the one that lives in a vehicle mount or a site office and gets picked up all day.
highlights: 10.1 inch screen — read a drawing without pinching and zooming
IP68 + IP69K, the highest sealing in the range
10800mAh battery, the biggest we fit
Dual SIM 4G for patchy rural coverage
products.positioning: The site tablet. Blueprints, BIM viewers, full spreadsheets, PDF plans.

products.name: Tuga WH6
products.shortFor: Legacy Windows software and network drives, in a holster.
products.description: A 6.5 inch rugged Windows 11 Pro handheld for professionals who need desktop software on the move. Run legacy apps, access network drives, and manage field data from a device that fits in a holster.
products.longDescription: The WH6 puts full Windows 11 Pro in your pocket. An Intel N100, 16GB of RAM and a 512GB SSD mean you can run the legacy Windows software your industry never moved off, reach network drives, and manage field data without compromise. Sealed to IP67 and drop tested to MIL-STD-810H, with a 10000mAh battery and 4G LTE. A barcode scanner variant is available for warehouse and logistics work, and a charging dock is sold separately for desk use.
highlights: Full Windows 11 Pro — not a mobile OS pretending
Intel N100, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD
Fits a holster, runs desktop software
Optional integrated 2D barcode scanner
products.positioning: Windows in your pocket for professionals who need desktop software on the move.

products.name: Tuga W8
products.shortFor: Windows software in the field, with real ports.
products.description: An 8 inch rugged Windows 11 Pro tablet with an Intel processor, full USB ports and HDMI output. For professionals who need Windows software in the field without giving up durability.
products.longDescription: The W8 puts full Windows 11 Pro in a rugged 8 inch body. An Intel Celeron N5100, 8GB of RAM and a 128GB SSD run your Windows software as they would on a desk. The port selection is the point: USB-C, USB-A and HDMI, so you can connect to whatever the job needs rather than carrying a bag of adapters. Sealed to IP67, with NFC and a pogo pin dock connector for desk mounting. A barcode scanner variant is available.
highlights: Full Windows 11 Pro in an 8 inch rugged body
USB-C, USB-A and HDMI — no adapter bag
Pogo pin dock connector for desk use
Optional integrated 2D barcode scanner
products.positioning: The 8 inch Windows tablet for professionals who need real software in the field.

products.name: Tuga W10
products.shortFor: Engineers and surveyors who need Ethernet, HDMI and a full screen.
products.description: A 10.1 inch rugged Windows 11 Pro tablet with an Intel processor and a full port selection including RJ45 Ethernet and HDMI. For engineers, surveyors and field professionals who need full desktop capability.
products.longDescription: The W10 is the full desktop experience in a rugged package. A 10.1 inch FHD display, Intel Celeron N5100, 8GB of RAM and a 128GB SSD run Windows 11 Pro without compromise. The port selection is what sets it apart: USB-C, USB-A, HDMI and RJ45 Ethernet for direct connections to plant, panels and network gear that has never seen Wi-Fi. Sealed to IP67, with a fingerprint sensor and pogo pin dock connector. Optional 2D barcode scanner and UHF reader variants are available.
highlights: RJ45 Ethernet — plug straight into panels and plant
10.1 inch FHD, full Windows 11 Pro
USB-C, USB-A, HDMI and Ethernet on board
Optional 2D barcode scanner and UHF reader
products.positioning: The full desktop experience. Real screen estate, full ports, full Windows.

products.name: Tuga WH6 with Barcode Scanner
products.tagline: Windows in your pocket. Scan anything.
products.description: The Tuga WH6 with an integrated 2D barcode scanner. Full Windows 11 Pro in a rugged handheld with professional scanning for warehouse, logistics and inventory work.
products.positioning: WH6 with integrated barcode scanner for warehouse and logistics.

products.name: Tuga W8 with 2D Scanner
products.description: The Tuga W8 with an integrated 2D barcode scanner. All the power of the standard W8 plus professional barcode scanning for inventory, warehouse and field service work.
products.positioning: W8 with integrated 2D scanner for warehouse and inventory work.

products.name: Tuga W10 with 2D Scanner
products.description: The Tuga W10 with an integrated 2D barcode scanner. The full 10.1 inch Windows experience plus professional scanning for large scale inventory, quality control and logistics operations.
products.positioning: W10 with integrated 2D scanner for warehouse and logistics.

accessories.name: Charging Dock
accessories.description: Desktop charging dock with a pogo pin connection. Drop the tablet in and it charges. No fiddling with cables in the dark.

accessories.name: Vehicle Mounting Dock

accessories.name: Hand Strap
accessories.description: Adjustable hand strap with 360 degree rotation. A secure grip for one handed use on a ladder or in a riser.

accessories.name: Capacitive Stylus
accessories.description: Precision capacitive stylus for signatures and detail work when the gloves are off. Includes a clip for a pocket or case.

accessories.name: Tempered Glass Screen Protector (2 Pack)
accessories.description: 9H tempered glass protectors. An extra layer of scratch and impact resistance. Two in the pack because you work on site, not in an office.

accessories.name: 12V DC Car Charger
accessories.description: 12V charger with USB-C output and a 2 metre cable. Fast charging between jobs without unplugging the sat nav.

accessories.name: Rugged Carry Case
accessories.description: Padded carry case with a shoulder strap and belt loop. Fits tablets up to 10.1 inches, with pockets for cables, charger and stylus.

accessories.name: Belt Holster
accessories.description: MOLLE compatible belt holster for rugged handhelds. Quick draw design with a magnetic closure. Fits devices up to 6.8 inches.

accessories.name: Car Phone Mount
accessories.description: Heavy duty suction cup mount for rugged handhelds. Holds devices up to 7 inches, one handed operation with gloves on.

accessories.name: USB-C to USB-A OTG Adapter
accessories.description: Plug in USB drives, keyboards, barcode scanners and other USB-A peripherals. Compact aluminium body, built to survive a toolbox.

accessories.name: Shoulder Strap
accessories.description: Adjustable padded shoulder strap with quick release clips. Keeps the tablet hands free while you move around site.
